# Slurm Scheduler (Scholar)

All real computation on Scholar runs as **Slurm** jobs. Never run compute on a login
node (see `unix.md`) — submit it here.

## Every Scholar job needs four things

A job request must specify **resources**, an **account**, a **QOS**, and a
**partition**. On Scholar you MUST explicitly set **both the account
(`-A`/`--account=`) and the partition (`-p`/`--partition=`)**; also set the QOS
(`-q`/`--qos=`) and always a time limit (`--time`).

- Discover the accounts you can submit to with **`slist`** — do not
  guess an account name.
- Set a realistic `--time`; memory is allocated in proportion to the cores you request.

## Partitions

| Partition | For | Notes |
|-----------|-----|-------|
| `cpu` | CPU jobs (`scholar-a`: 128 cores, 256 GB; `scholar-b`: 64 cores, 256 GB) | `-A scholar`; QOS `normal` (default, up to 4 h), `long` (up to 3 days) or `debug` (30 min) |
| `gpu` | NVIDIA GPU jobs (V100, A30, A30 MIG slices, A40 nodes) | `-A scholar`; request GPUs with `--gres=gpu:N` or `--gpus-per-node=N` |
| `spark-batch` | NVIDIA GB10 (DGX Spark) nodes with exclusive resources; aarch64, Ubuntu 24.04 | `-A scholar`; `module load modtree/spark` first; x86_64 binaries do not run |
| `spark-interactive` | NVIDIA GB10 (DGX Spark) nodes, shared, for interactive work; aarch64 | `-A scholar`; `module load modtree/spark` first; x86_64 binaries do not run |

## QOS

- **`normal`** — the default; jobs up to 4 hours.
- **`long`** — jobs longer than 4 hours, up to 3 days, at lower priority. Request it with **`-q long`**.
- **`debug`** — high priority for testing: one running job, up to 2 nodes, 30 minutes. Request it with **`-q debug`**.

## Common commands

`sbatch` (submit a batch script), `squeue -u $USER` (your jobs), `scontrol show job
<id>` (job detail), `scontrol hold`/`release`, `scancel <id>` (cancel), `sinteractive`
(interactive job), `srun` (launch tasks).

## Prohibitions

- **Do NOT** request a `standby`, `preemptible`, or `training` QOS. Scholar has none; its QOS are `normal`, `long` and `debug`.
- **Do NOT** request more than 4 hours under the default `normal` QOS; add `-q long` for jobs up to 3 days.
- **Do NOT** invent an account name. The documented account is `scholar` (`-A scholar`); check `slist` for the accounts available to you.
- **Do NOT** submit to the `gpu` partition without requesting GPUs (`--gres=gpu:N` or `--gpus-per-node=N`).
- **Do NOT** assume `ai`, `smallgpu`, `highmem`, `a10`/`a30`/`a100-*` or `training` partitions. Those belong to other RCAC clusters; Scholar's partitions are `cpu`, `gpu`, `spark-batch` and `spark-interactive`.
- **Do NOT** emit flags for other schedulers (PBS/Torque `#PBS`, LSF `#BSUB`) — this is
  Slurm.
- **Do NOT** invent partition or QOS names; the valid sets are listed above.
- **Do NOT** submit jobs without a `--time` limit, and **do NOT** `scancel` jobs you do
  not own or run bulk cancellations without confirming with the user.
